title: al-Shāfiya, the summit of ṣarf
summary: Ibn al-Ḥājib's handbook of morphology, read last on every path, with Raḍī al-Dīn's commentary.

sections.heading: The book
paragraphs: Al-Shāfiya is the ṣarf companion of al-Kāfiya: the patterns of nouns and verbs, plurals, diminutives, iʿlāl and the rules of writing. Raḍī al-Dīn al-Astarābādhī's commentary on it is the fullest classical treatment of ṣarf.
On all three of The Nahwi's paths it stands at the end of the ṣarf books.
